title: The Garden of Sandpiper Point
author: Elodie Halloran
blurb: Sable Ishikawa, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
